map.由驱动转矩与力臂估算两指总夹持力。: Estimate the total two-finger grip force from the drive torque and lever arm.
map.关节力矩换夹持力。: Turning joint torque into clamping force.
map.力控夹爪设定。: Setting up a force controlled gripper.
map.F=2τ/L=2×5/0.05=200N；双侧夹持共提供 200N 法向力。: F = 2τ/L = 2 x 5/0.05 = 200 N; the two sides together supply 200 N of normal force.
map.L=0.1 → F=100N，力臂越长夹持力越小。: L = 0.1 gives F = 100 N; a longer lever arm means a smaller clamping force.
map.对称双边夹爪各由力矩产生法向力，合力为 2τ/L。: A symmetric two-sided gripper produces a normal force from the torque on each side, giving a total of 2τ/L.
map.与夹紧不滑？: Will the grip hold without slipping?
map.需 F·μ≥工件重/外扰，μ 为摩擦系数。: It needs F·μ to be at least the workpiece weight plus disturbances, where μ is the friction coefficient.
